game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round, smoke serpents strike the ash barrier, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ash barrier from smoke serpents in Vent Garden: keep the slot_matches meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: slot_matches drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while slot_matches > 0.
